headline: Video: Direction of Big Investor Fund Flows Faces MSCI and High Interest Rate Risks
summary: A CNBC Indonesia video examines where large investors are directing funds amid risks linked to MSCI index decisions, war and high interest rates.
why: MSCI index reviews determine passive fund flows into emerging markets, so changes in weighting can move local equity markets.
original_headline: Video: Arah Aliran Dana Investor Kakap Hadapi Risiko MSCI-Bunga Tinggi
